Man City manager expresses trust amid Premier League charges

Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca stated he has complete trust in the club following a guilty verdict on charges. He revealed the mood in the squad in his first interview since the verdict. Striker Erling Haaland called for Manchester City fans to 'stick together'. The Daily Mirror reported that Manchester City held settlement talks with the Premier League before the guilty verdict on charges.
